instruction: Could you configure Chrome to automatically group tabs by website domain and display them in separate colored tab groups? This would help me organize my browsing sessions better, especially when I have many tabs open from different websites.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not have an automatic tab grouping feature that organizes tabs by domain. While Chrome supports manual tab groups, there is no setting to automatically group tabs by website domain or apply colored groups automatically based on domain.
